mentions.name: Modular hobbyist analog computer
mentions.description: A modular hobbyist analog computer whose hardware build is complete and whose manual is being finished. Pendulum simulations wired into it drive an XY oscilloscope to produce Lissajous curves; the next step is doubling to four pendulums, with each axis driven by the sum of an out-of-phase pair of pendulums, and eventually hooking it up to an actual plotter.
mentions.source_excerpt: Closing up work on my modular, hobbyist, analog computer. (Finishing up the manual—the hardware is already a wrap).
